scope: Executable research evidence only; no new hosted calls, external scientific replication, full repository CI, publication or deployment.

supporting.scope: Supporting studies only; excludes later opportunity-led extensions and publication/release validation.

preserved_corrections: economic recipient shift and H scope

archived_output_replay.limits: Saved-output replay only; assertions are not independent tasks and elapsed time is not a replicated treatment effect.

conditional_economics.summary_reconstruction: exact JSON equality for both editions

existing_value_verifier.limitation: Summary/accounting identities and immutable-source checks; not independent market validation.

conditional_economics.event_stream_verification: Both compressed stream SHA-256 bindings checked; individual events are not independently re-audited by this script.
conditional_economics.limits: All economic histories are conditional simulations. Re-execution does not validate assumptions or recreate frontier behavior.

prospective_prescreen.limit: New artificial candidate process; not repaired historical profit or empirical skill value.

source_commitments.confirmation_summary_binding: Post-result archive binding; not described as a prospective commitment.

protocol_controls.semantic_prose_review: Human-readable explanations still require internal reviewer inspection; automated acceptance relies primarily on numerical/source and explicit scope fields.

development_and_oracle.oracle_independence: Source reaction identifiers, SVD nullspace and Poisson uniformization; does not import retained instrument or conventional method.
development_and_oracle.scope: Internal computational validation; no external scientific or biological validation.

confirmation.independence_limit: One campaign over two public source families; H4 was used in development. Changed requests are not independent opportunities.
confirmation.prose_review: Separately documented in validation/opportunity_review.md; string-length checks alone do not validate explanations.

arrangement.scope: Exact analysis of supplied assumptions and finite menus; not S3 market or revenue evidence.

admission_observation.native_scope: Unsupported scientific workflow; original native scope unchanged
